{{Top|leg}}
'''Launch Control''' was an operation that maintained launching procedures.

[[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] had a Launch Control, which remotely controlled vessels before launch through their [[astromech droid/Legends|astromech units]]. After pilots of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] surrendered control of their ships to Launch Control, the R2s taxied them to the opening, and launched them. Launch Control led the ships until their target destination, before relinquishing control back to the pilots.<ref>{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>

There was a Launch Control room aboard the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. It was destroyed during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] </ref>
